case_title: RCT INTERNATIONAL VS LOW MAI NGON

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY RCT INTERNATIONAL AS TO DEFENDANT LOW MAI NGON ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-14-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 07
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT LOW MAI NGON

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RCT INTERNATIONAL RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT LOW MAI NGON $200.00 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $200.00, RETURN OF $200 CLEANING DEPOSIT W/IN 2 WKS UPON RECEIPT OF JUDGMENT BY MAIL TO PLTF'S ADDRESS STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
